title.en: Explicit sieve and prime-counting analytic inputs
title.zh: 显式筛法与素数分布解析输入

description.en: Standalone explicit prime-power differences, Abel summation bridges (Chebyshev θ to π/li and reciprocal prime sums), primitive-character Euler-factor loss, compact smoothing-kernel Mellin bounds, and multiplicative large sieve lifting for explicit Goldbach and Chen-type sieves.
description.zh: 为显式哥德巴赫与陈氏筛提供通用的独立解析输入：显式素数幂差、切比雪夫函数到素数计数与素数倒数和的分部求和桥、本原特征欧拉因子损失、紧支撑光滑核 Mellin 衰减界，以及由加法大筛提升的乘性大筛不等式。
